class.name: TamaEmitter
class.brief_description: A Node2D that runs a TamaScript bullet pattern.
class.description:
[b]TamaEmitter[/b] is the main scene node for playing back a TamaScript pattern. Add one to your scene, assign [member script_filename], and call [method start] to begin firing.
[b]TamaScript exports[/b] — variables declared with [code]export[/code] in the script appear as inspector properties under the [i]TamaScript Exports[/i] group and can be overridden per-emitter without editing the script. They can also be set at runtime with [method set_export].
[b]Hot-reload[/b] — while the game is running, TamaEmitter polls the script file for changes every second. When a change is detected, exports are refreshed automatically so the inspector stays in sync.
Multiple emitters can share the same script file; each maintains independent state.

method.name: start
method.description: Begins executing the TamaScript pattern from the [code]main[/code] block. Has no effect if the emitter is already running.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the running pattern. In-flight bullets are not destroyed.

method.name: set_export
method.description: Sets a TamaScript export variable by name. The value is passed to the script the next time the emitter starts (or live if it is already running).

method.name: set_export_num
method.description: Convenience variant of [method set_export] for numeric values.

method.name: set_export_str
method.description: Convenience variant of [method set_export] for string values.

method.name: set_export_bool
method.description: Convenience variant of [method set_export] for boolean values.

method.name: get_export
method.description: Returns the current value of a TamaScript export variable, or [code]null[/code] if it does not exist.

members.member: The bare filename of the TamaScript to run (without path or extension), e.g. [code]"spiral"[/code]. The file must have been loaded by [TamaManager] before the emitter starts.
When [code]true[/code], this emitter is excluded from group-wide [code]start[/code]/[code]stop[/code] calls.
